nodes.title: Coaching a designer to turn incremental work into a long-term vision
nodes.summary: The designer was thinking near term and I helped to see the opportunity to step up and be a strategic design partner.
nodes.result: A long term vision that aligned the teams roadmap and created a more comprehensive solution to near a near term project
